root_cause: The adapter maps source_site/target_site 2 to geometric right and 4 to geometric left, but writes raw OOXML idx=site-1. The rectangle preset renders idx 1 on the left and idx 3 on the right. Horizontal bindings therefore render opposite to their planned sides.
operations: Delete only the four defective named connectors, recreate with left/right native-site argument remapping 2<->4. Keep top/bottom 1 and 3 unchanged. Inspect the actual renderer; do not accept the initial all-clear geometry audit as proof.
preserve: All node geometry, exact stage labels, budgets and freeze text; existing vertical connectors.
acceptance: Rendered arrows exit the source's intended boundary and enter target's intended boundary without traversing node text, while native bindings remain attached and audit has no hard failure.
rollback_signal: Any unrelated node moves, changed label, crossed label, or new hard audit finding.
